change.description: Add crash-safe autonomous archive recovery finalization and quarantine retirement, bounded historical raw-file reconciliation, an additive raw-capture circuit contract, a separately scheduled bounded orphan sweep, and System Status health fields.
change.release_unit_description: Autonomous retention recovery, raw capture circuit breaker, and raw orphan sweep throughput.

planned.reasoning: The system-status fields are optional/additive; new counters may be unknown until measured. New SQLite tables and raw-capture columns are additive and earlier binaries may ignore them. No existing field or archive format is changed.

scope_drift.description: No public API or durable-state compatibility scope drift.

current.reasoning: The candidate adds optional runtimePressureHealth.rawOrphanSweep diagnostics while reusing the existing raw_payload_files cursor retry/progress columns without new DDL. Earlier binaries remain safe because their bounded filename cursor wraps through the tail; archive wire/file formats and existing response fields remain unchanged. Every bounded raw filesystem inspection is pressure-gated, with the background pressure slot retained only for the inspection while the SQLite write-coordinator permit is released; dry-run quarantine counts report completed mutations only.

verified.reasoning: Source commit 09e36b44d4fc08dcd85d77b2d28a52bc56bdb3c4 passes the refreshed Linux Rust checks and both required SQLite profiles. The raw orphan worker reuses existing cursor state and introduces no DDL; System Status diagnostics remain optional and additive. Every raw filesystem-inspection admission boundary and dry-run count semantics have focused regression coverage.
